decisions.reason: Featured on the home page, the transactional email service is a strategic cloud option whose prospects are still uncertain but promising, and it is cheap to keep running on existing mail infrastructure.
With a dedicated page, the document capture service signals deliberate investment, and one year is too early to resolve its value, so the option stays open.
Email-fax conversion fits the firm's established messaging business at low marginal cost, so keeping it is inexpensive despite fax being a declining market.
This feature has only minor visibility and is in a shrinking fax niche, but as an add-on to existing fax services it costs little to retain while results remain unclear.
Demand for email sandbox threat protection is growing, and the feature complements the firm's security portfolio, so the option is worth holding.
Multi-engine scanning is a low-cost extension of existing email security, and its value is still uncertain rather than disproven.
